snippet.title: Way of the Hunter 2 | Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The trail starts here: Way of the Hunter 2 is OUT NOW in Early Access on Steam! Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the Canadian wilderness.

Way of the Hunter 2 is fully playable in Early Access, offering a solid core experience, but remains a work in progress by design. By opening development early, the team ensures that your feedback can meaningfully influence systems, mechanics, and future content while we are still flexible and evolving.

Check out the FAQ if you have any questions: https://thqn.net/woth2-faq
